## Enhance LINE features
K2ge3Air is a tweak that adds convenient features not available in the official LINE app.

screenshots.accessibilityText: A LINE conversation showing unsent message retention and the Read Users action
Local display-name settings for friends, groups, and open chats

views.markdown:
- iPad Login
- Display Read Users
- Hide Read Status
- Disable unsend
- Manage Themes
- Remove Ads
- Change Display Names
- Manage Tabs
- Add Confirmation Prompts

For full details and purchase information, please visit the [official website](https://m4fn3.github.io/repo/web/K2ge3Air.html).

## 1.0.7 - 2025-12-26
- Fixed the K2ge3Air settings view crashing on some devices.

## 1.0.6 - 2025-12-24
- Added support for LINE 14.x and iOS 15.
- Improved Send Confirmation wording.

## 1.0.5 - 2025-12-22
- Removed the fixed LINE-version dependency.
- Fixed multiple features on LINE 15.20.4 and a Send Confirmation crash on iOS 26.

## 1.0.4 - 2025-10-22
- Added sticker copying and MID copying.
- Fixed issues with the message long-press menu.

## 1.0.3 - 2025-10-10
- Added support for retaining messages unsent in the background.
- Fixed display names in OpenChat and other issues.

## 1.0.2 - 2025-10-07
- Added sideloading support and improved iPad Login.

## 1.0.1 - 2025-10-06
- Fixed license saving and the missing settings button during iPad Login.
- Fixed Read Users visibility and Send Confirmation crashes in some environments.

## 1.0.0 - 2025-10-05
- Initial release.
